product.name: Struct PIM
product.description: A product information management system that centralizes and manages product data across multiple channels and platforms.

product.name: AI Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered tool within Struct PIM that automates the creation and translation of product content at scale.

product.name: Publications
product.description: A tool to convert product data from Struct PIM into customizable PDF publications and data-only templates.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: Prebuilt and custom connectors that link Struct PIM with ERP, e-commerce, CMS, DAM, marketplaces, and other business systems.
